facts.text: Ireton was named after Henry Ireton, a prominent English Revolutionary General, when the town was platted in 1882.
The city was officially platted in 1882, marking the start of its development along the Big Sioux River.
A post office has been in operation in Ireton since 1882, serving the community for over a century.
Indian Creek, a tributary of the Big Sioux River, winds through the northern part of Ireton, adding a natural waterway to the town.
Ireton Christian School, a local educational institution, is situated within the city and serves families in the area.
In its early days, Ireton boasted a jewelry store, furniture store, bakery, a dentist, and two doctors, reflecting a bustling small‑town economy.
